title: Blow-up phenomena for the $σ_2$-Yamabe equation
summary: For every integer $n\ge27$, we construct a smooth metric on $\mathbb S^n$ that is invariant under the antipodal map and is not locally conformally flat. For this fixed background metric, the normalized $σ_2$-Yamabe equation admits a noncompact family of positive $Γ_2^+$-admissible solutions. The main difficulty is the possible loss of ellipticity of the linearized operator. This difficulty does not occur for the scalar Yamabe equation, whose linearization has a fixed Laplace-type principal part.
